```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(parallel)
options(digitis = 3)
options(scipen = 10^5)
options(help_type = "html")

#load R functions
sapply(list.files("R/", ".r", full.names = TRUE), source)
set.seed(0203)
options(scipen = 10^6)


library(gt)
```


```{r}
sim_files <- list.files("data/", "wcov_imputation_", full.names = TRUE)
sim_list <- lapply(sim_files, readRDS)
pnames <- basename(sim_files)
pnames <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", pnames)
pnames <- gsub("wcov_imputation_", "", pnames)
pnames
names(sim_list) <- pnames

# Combine and keep an id column (`sid`) with the source filename
fits <- rbindlist(sim_list, idcol = "sid", fill = TRUE)
# Parse `model` and `dgp` from the filename. Expecting names like
# imputation_results_<model>_<dgp>.rds; adjust the splitting if your filenames differ.
fits[, c("model", "dgp") := tstrsplit(sid, "_", keep = 1:2)]
table(fits$model)
table(fits$dgp)


fits[, dgp := ordered(dgp, levels = 1:3
       , labels = c("MAR", "Latent level", "Latent trend")
     )]
fits[, s := year - start_year_sim]
fits[, nc := ordered(urb != "6.NonCore", labels = c("NonCore", "Core"))]

order <- c("twfe", "etwfe", "rw", "rwi", "rwst", "xgb")
fits[, model := ordered(model, levels = order
       , labels = c("TWFE", "ETWFE", "RW", "RW-IID", "RW-ST", "GB-Ens")
     )]
fits$model |> table()
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Pre-period unit-by-model RMSE (your start, kept)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
unit_model_rmse <- fits[s < 0, .(
  rmse_pre = sqrt(mean((y - y0_hat)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_pre = .N
), by = .(dgp, r, nc, i, model)]

unit_model_rmse |> dim()
# Quick diagnostics
unit_model_rmse[, .(summary = list(mean(is.na(rmse_pre)))), by = model]
unit_model_rmse[, .(q95 = quantile(rmse_pre, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)), by = model]

fits[unit_model_rmse, rmse_pre := i.rmse_pre, on = .(dgp, r, i, model)]

```


```{r}
# keep years 0..4
fits <- fits[s >= 0 & s <= 4]
fits <- fits[!is.na(y0_hat)]
table(with(fits, table(year < start_year_sim)))
table(with(fits, table(year < start_year)))
fits[, .(i, year, start_year, start_year_sim, s, y, y0_hat)]


fits[, .N, by = .(dgp, r, i, s)] |> with(summary(N))
ok <- fits[, .N, by = .(dgp, r, i, s)][N == 6]
# keep only those rows in original (non-aggregated) fits
fits <- fits[ok, on = .(dgp, r, i, s), nomatch = 0L]
dim(fits)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(fits, "data/sim_fits_wcov.rds")
```
